choice: UpdateClass carries an optional UpdateScope, computed only on the non-trivial path
why: one clone fetch and one injected classifier; every existing fake keeps working with the None default

choice: _settle_update returns the UpdateScope (or None) and _t2 passes it to _queue_review
why: approved_head is cleared right after the review is queued, so the scope travels inside one _t2 call with no per-poll side table

choice: the oldest first-parent commit after the approved head is a two-parent merge whose second parent is on base; every later first-parent commit has one parent
why: any other shape (rebase, second base merge, git error) returns None and the job gets the full review

choice: facts_of reads update facts only for review jobs with kind=update and well-formed shas
why: malformed detail fails closed to the full review; fix-round snapshots stay byte-identical

choice: the update step replaces both "Read the whole diff" and "Close the earlier rounds"
why: every finding was closed at the approval, so closing earlier rounds would contradict a merge-only review

choice: list at most 50 later commits and state the total
why: keeps the brief bounded on a long post-merge history

choice: the main job wrote the diff instead of a poteto-agent delegate
why: about 120 lines across one seam inside a 60-minute wall clock; the cross-family Codex review supplies review separation
